links.comparator_used: No explicit comparator arm; the implicit baseline is exhaustive review of all transcript tokens
links.outcome: Share of human-verified transcription errors recovered by flagged positions versus share of tokens flagged for review
links.effect: Flagging positions where six or fewer of eight ASR systems agreed selected 28.6% of tokens and recovered 93.7% of single-annotator HC-verified errors. Errors rose monotonically as agreement fell. Only 2.5% of positions were high-risk (0-3 systems agreeing).
links.tradeoff: About 6.3% of errors were not flagged. Agreement among all systems does not guarantee correctness, because shared errors go undetected. The threshold was post hoc and illustrative, validation used a single annotator, and the corpus was a proxy medical-education set rather than clinical encounters.
links.quote: At an illustrative post hoc threshold, flagging positions where six or fewer systems agreed selected 28.6% of tokens while recovering 93.7% of single-annotator HC-verified errors on this proxy corpus.

design_hint: cross-model ASR disagreement to prioritize human review
